Junk Removal Services in Sudbury

Hauled away by one local crew, anywhere in Greater Sudbury.

Furniture and Mattress Removal

Furniture and mattresses you no longer want are carried out, loaded up and hauled away. You don't have to drag anything to the curb.

Appliance Removal

Replacing an appliance or getting rid of one? Fridges, freezers, air conditioners and other appliances: we carry them out and take them away.

Yard Waste and Renovation Debris

Piles of yard waste and debris left over from a renovation are loaded up and taken away, so your yard, driveway or garage is clear again.

Garage, Basement and Shed Cleanouts

Clearing out a garage, a basement or a shed? Walk us through it and we'll carry everything out for you.

We also take tires, electronics and batteries. We don't take paint, chemicals, propane tanks or other hazardous waste.

Junk Removal Questions

What kinds of junk do you take?

Furniture, mattresses, appliances (fridges, freezers and air conditioners included), tires, electronics, batteries, yard waste and renovation debris. We also do garage, basement and shed cleanouts.

Do I have to help carry anything?

No. You just point to what goes and our crew takes care of the rest.

What can't you take?

Paint, chemicals, propane tanks or any other hazardous waste.

Where does my junk go?

To the landfill. Anything still usable is donated or recycled where possible.

Can you pick up junk the same day?

It's possible. Call or WhatsApp 705-562-9047 and we'll tell you when we can be there.

How much does junk removal cost in Sudbury?

Every job is quoted on its own, based on its size and what you need hauled away, so we don't publish set prices. Text or WhatsApp a photo to 705-562-9047 for a free, no-obligation estimate.

Do you cover my area?

We pick up junk all over Greater Sudbury, from New Sudbury and the South End to Hanmer, Chelmsford, Lively and Garson. See all the areas we serve.
